title: {item:longsword}
text:
一把{item:longsword}：一下 {item_stat:longsword:damage} 点，慢，但总伤害比{item:knife}高得多。对付血厚、没什么花样的对手用它最省事。

再搜一次，还有一样东西。

texts.en:
A {item:longsword}: {item_stat:longsword:damage} damage a swing. Slow, but far more total damage than the {item:knife}. Against an enemy with lots of Health and no tricks, it's the easy choice.

Search again. There's one more thing.
